Q: Selenium ChromeDriver not working in JavaFX application packaged as an exe A:

You saw it right.

Selenium Manager

The Selenium project has integrated Selenium Manager the official driver manager for Selenium which is shipped out of the box with each Selenium release since version 4.6. Selenium Manager is a command-line tool which is being implemented in Rust that provides automated driver and browser management for Selenium. Currently all the Selenium bindings use this tool by default, so you do not need to download it or add bonigarcia:webdrivermanager or do anything else to use it. Selenium Manager is the official driver manager of the Selenium project, and it is shipped out of the box with every Selenium release.

So invariably Selenium v4.40.0 does includes the support of Selenium Manager.

Further this log message:

SeleniumUtil - next line is new ChromeDriver(). Driver system location: C:\Users\cdavi\.cache\selenium\chromedriver\win64\144.0.7559.133\chromedriver.exe

is perfect, the current latest official google-chrome browser version being Version 144.0.7559.133

Issue & Solution

Most possible reason behind your class hangs is because of a few unwanted arguments. Comment out the following arguments which are not mandatory for google-chrome-headless:

options.addArguments("--disable-background-networking");
options.addArguments("--remote-debugging-pipe");

Additionally remove the line:

WebDriverManager.chromedriver().setup();

to stop using WebDriverManager.

Further ensure that Selenium is upgraded to recent v4.40 and then re-execute your class.

Q: How to substitute %{REQUEST_FILENAME} with only the domain relevant address? A:

Dumb question from me, sorry. I read the Apache https://httpd.apache.org/docs/2.4/expr.html#vars details twice before the third time seeing the one I needed:

%{REQUEST_URI} The path part of the request's URI

So therefore :

RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-f
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-d
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} !\.
RewriteRule ^file/([a-z0-9-]+)/?$ /result.php?key=$1 [NC,L]

Works.

%{REQUEST_URI} does not contain any Query String values on our/this server. It is entirely just the path under the domain.

Q: How to use unsplash to generate different random images within a loop A:

Try putting a time stamp on the end of the url with the current date/date, this should do the trick. For example, the below img source will generate a new random image for the catagory 'pilates' everytime it's loaded. If you want another category, just change the key word 'pilates' to something else:

 <img src="https://source.unsplash.com/random/?pilates#<%+new Date().getTime()%>" alt="" />

Q: ChartJS not rendering lines according to x-axis data A:

This is because you are using a line chart with default config.

By default a line chart uses a category scale and expects strings. In the dataset you specify an x, this x is the internal data format which for the category scale is not the value but the index.

The easyest approach would be to use a linear scale by setting options.scales.x.type to 'linear'
